help.summary: Checks CMiC's AWS SaaS WebLogic log index for servers whose logs stopped updating; a growing count can mean servers or their log copying have stopped.
help.details: Runs on a server inside CMiC's network (the log index is VPN only) and counts servers whose log folder hasn't changed for 30 minutes.
